---
title: "Bharay Madinay Main"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Yeh Haal Ho Gaya Baba Bharay Madine Mein
Akeli Ho Gayi Zahra Bharay Madine Mein
Hamara Jalta Howa Ghar Bhujaney Ki Khatir
Rasan Ali Ke Galay Se Churane Ki Khatir
Koi Bhi Ghar Se Na Nikla Bharay Madine Mein
Haye Woh Jis Ko Bizato Mini Khud Aap Kehte They
Ghazab Hai Aap Ki Oss Pardah Daar Beti Pe
Kissi Ne Hath Uthaya Bharay Madine Mein
Haye Yeh Dukh Sakina Ko Zainab Mera Suna Dena
Ossay Tu Sham-e-Ghareebaan Mein Shimar Marey Ga
Mujhe Laga Hai Tamacha Bharay Madine Mein
Ghadeer Yaad Dilaney Gharon Pe Jati Hoon
Main Unn Pe Dastakein De De Ke Laut Aati Hoon
Koi Bhi Dar Nahi Khulta Bharay Madine Mein
Aray Thi Mere Samne Rasi Mein Gardan-e-Haider
Mujhe Ali Ne Na Oss Waqt Roka Hota Agar
Na Rehta Koi Bhi Zindah Bharay Madine Mein
Hamarey Ghar Ka Dhowaan Bhi Nazar Na Aaya Unhein
Na Mere Bachoon Ki Aahoon Ne Bhi Jagaya Unhein
Sakoon Se So Gayi Dunya Bharay Madine Mein
Main Bait-e-Hizn Mein Jati Thi Aap Ko Roney
Ossay Bhi Aag Laga Di Hai Kalma Goyon Ne
Main Ro Bhi Payi Na Baba Bharay Madine Mein
Aye Baba Mujh Ko Yehi Baat Khaye Jati Hai
Koi Bhi Keh Nahi Paya Batool Sachi Hai
Kaha Gaya Mujhe Jhota Bharay Madine Mein
Haye Abu Turab Se Keh Kar Mujhe Bulaya Tha
Aray Yeh Shehar Aap Ne Kya Iss Liye Basaya Tha
Batool Khati Hai Durrah Bharay Madine Mein
Sitam Hai Ab Bhi TAKALLUM Batool Par Jari
Jahan Pe Qabrein Hain Zahra Ke Chaar Beton Ki
Hai Bas Wahin Pe Andhera Bharay Madine Mein
